constraints: fontObj.family is mandatory; fontObj.size, style, variant, and weight are optional.

fontObj.size accepts a number with a CSS-style unit (em, ex, %, px, cm, mm, in, pt, pc, ch, rem, vh, vw, vmin, vmax), one of the vk font size * constants, or a font-size/line-height pair like "15pt/20pt".

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns a CSS-style font shorthand string built from the properties of fontObj.
